name: Holds and retention per mailbox
description: Shows litigation hold, in-place and retention policy holds, delay holds, retention hold and the retention policy on each mailbox, with the organisation-wide holds.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Mailboxes
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to check every mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: OnlyOnHold
parameters.label: Only mailboxes with a hold
parameters.help: List only mailboxes with a hold set on the mailbox. A mailbox whose holds could not be read is kept.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: When no mailbox is named, stops after this many and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients and organisation configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Hold IDs are shown as Exchange returns them and are not resolved to policy or case names; that needs Security and Compliance PowerShell, which this library does not connect to.
Organisation-wide holds are listed for reference on every row; whether one covers a given mailbox is not worked out.
Retention hold pauses retention processing; it is reported but does not by itself make HoldStatus MailboxHold.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
